key_insight: Training the PV forecaster to optimize battery scheduling decisions, not just forecast accuracy, produced lower electricity costs.
engineering_relevance: For residential PV-battery systems, decision-focused learning can improve operational savings even when standard prediction metrics get worse.
method: Train an LSTM PV forecast model end-to-end with the downstream battery scheduling objective.
Compare decision-focused learning against a standard two-phase forecast-then-optimize pipeline.
Test warm-starting to improve optimization cost and stabilize forecast error.
evidence_signal: Over a 14-month evaluation on 20 buildings, the decision-focused method reduced average electricity costs by 3.6% versus bounds from perfect forecast and no optimization, with statistically significant results at p<0.001.
watch_item: The approach improved cost while increasing RMSE in the main setting, so deployment must balance economic gains against reduced forecast accuracy and possible sensitivity to dataset-specific conditions.
paper_title: Decision-focused learning for optimal PV-Battery scheduling
